name: Reg Parnell
features: fair skin, dark hair, light eyes, round heavy face, thickset build, blunt cheerful expression
bio: A Derby haulage contractor who bought his way into racing with a Maserati 4CL and became the best British driver of the immediate post-war years. Parnell finished third in the 1950 British Grand Prix, the first World Championship race ever held, and later managed the Aston Martin and Lola teams.
